messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Velociti Logistics (Carlos) just flagged an expansion. Three new EU cross-dock teams want to go live next month, each expecting ~150 QPS peak for realtime summaries + embeddings.
Tom: Wait, that's ~450 QPS peak total plus embeddings. They're currently on the Standard hosted plan. Do we have recommendations?
Priya: Do we know models and avg token lengths? Carlos mentioned 'summarizer-v2' and 'embed-lite'. He said average response ~250 tokens.
Kyle: Quick infra note: sustained 450 QPS with ~250 tokens hits shared pools hard. Without a dedicated pool we risk p95 latency > 400ms during peak.
Maya: Renewal timeline: they renew in ~9 weeks. If they see latency on go-live this could become a negotiation lever. We should avoid that.
Tom: Proposal idea: offer a 6-week dedicated pilot in eu-west with autoscale & a modest commit (15%). If pilot shows perf improvements, roll into committed capacity for longer term. Thoughts?
Priya: From a perf side I want to validate batching + prefix caching efficacy. I'll run a quick sim: `python perf_sim.py --qps 450 --avg-tokens 250 --model summarizer-v2` and share numbers.
Priya: Quick sim result (local run): shared-host p95 token latency ~360ms, throughput starts dropping after sustained 300 QPS. Dedicated pilot estimate: p95 ~140ms, stable at 500 QPS with two gpus. I'll export the trace.
Kyle: ops check: eu-west cluster currently has one available pod slot; we can provision 2x dedicated gpus for a pilot, provisioning ETA ~48h if approved.
Maya: Action items: Tom to draft pilot commercial (timeline + pricing), Priya to attach perf sims and traces, Kyle to reserve capacity and confirm costs. I'll schedule call with Carlos for Thurs 11:00 CET to align.
Tom: On it. I'll include a short ROI note: reduced latency -> better worker throughput for their cross-dock flows, plus lower error rates.
Priya: Uploading perf artifacts: https://internal.redwood/perf/velociti/sim-1769991234 (includes flame graphs, p95 breakdowns, batching configs).
Kyle: deploy-bot queued provisioning job `provision-dedicated-velociti-pilot` with request id r-vel-176999. ETA 48h :rocket:
deploy-bot: Job r-vel-176999 accepted, pending capacity checks and cost approval.
Maya: Great — if pilot numbers match estimates we can turn this into a low-friction expansion and mitigate renewal risk. I will post a short playbook for the customer call. :thumbsup:
